h1: The 7 Best Mini Printers for Small Spaces of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Mini Printers, Small Spaces: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: seven compact printers for small spaces, from inkless thermal models to Canon, HP and Epson all-in-ones, with tradeoffs.
summary: The Epson EcoTank ET-2800 is the best pick if you print often, thanks to refillable ink tanks. The Canon TR160 is the true portable with a battery, the HP DeskJet 4355 and Canon TR4720 handle scanning, and the NDYIN and Gloryang inkless thermal printers fit a drawer.
intro: A small printer is not always a cheap one. The mistake buyers make is choosing the smallest body and then paying for it every month in cartridges, or choosing an inkless thermal model that cannot do color at all.
We reviewed seven compact printers and ranked them on the spec sheet: footprint, ink system, scan and copy features, connectivity and portability. Everything below is based on listed specifications.

products.name: Epson EcoTank ET-2800 Wireless Color All-in-One Cartridge-Free Ink Supertank Printer
products.verdict: Refillable ink tanks, scanning and wireless printing for frequent printers.
products.description:
The ET-2800 is a color all-in-one with cartridge-free refillable ink tanks, a flatbed scanner and copier, and wireless network printing. It ships with startup ink bottles.

It wins because the tank system targets ongoing cost, which is where compact inkjets hurt most. The tradeoff against the Canon PIXMA TS4320 is a similar footprint class but a different ink approach.

Buy it if you print often in color. Skip it if you want the smallest body.
products.idealFor: Small home offices that print color often.
products.skipIf: You print rarely and need the smallest body.

products.name: Canon PIXMA TR160 Wireless Portable Lightweight Compact Printer with Battery
products.verdict: A rechargeable battery lets it print away from an outlet.
products.description:
The TR160 has a rechargeable battery, a 1.44 inch display, a 50-sheet paper tray and wireless connectivity in a lightweight body.

It ranks second because it is the only inkjet here that can go cordless, but it lists no scanner, which the Epson has.

It suits people who print at home and occasionally on trips. The caveat is no scan or copy.
products.idealFor: People who print at home and on trips.
products.skipIf: You need to scan or copy.

products.name: Canon PIXMA TS4320 Wireless Color Inkjet Printer for Duplex Printing
products.verdict: A small color inkjet with duplex printing and a scanner.
products.description:
The TS4320 is a compact color inkjet with duplex printing, a flatbed scanner and copier, and wireless connectivity. Setup is described as easy.

It ranks third because it offers duplex printing the HP does not list, but it uses regular cartridges, unlike the Epson.

Choose it if you want the smallest true color inkjet. The caveat is ongoing cartridge cost.
products.idealFor: Small desks needing color and duplex.

products.name: HP DeskJet 4355 Wireless All-in-One Color Inkjet Printer, Scanner, Copier
products.verdict: Compact all-in-one with scan and copy and the HP Smart app.
products.description:
The DeskJet 4355 is a compact all-in-one with scanning, copying, wireless printing, HP Smart app support and a 3-month Instant Ink trial.

It ranks fourth because it lacks the duplex listing of the Canon TS4320, but it adds app control.

It suits small spaces that want scan and copy. The caveat is the Instant Ink trial is temporary.
products.idealFor: Small spaces needing basic all-in-one use.

products.name: Canon PIXMA TR4720 All-in-One Wireless Printer with Auto Document Feeder
products.verdict: An auto document feeder for multi-page scanning in a compact body.
products.description:
The TR4720 adds an auto document feeder to a compact wireless all-in-one with built-in fax.

It ranks fifth because the feeder adds bulk compared with the TS4320, but it is the only one here with fax.

Buy it for occasional multi-page scanning. The caveat is the larger feel.
products.idealFor: Multi-page scanning in a compact space.

products.name: Gloryang Inkless Portable Printer, Wireless Thermal Printer with Carry Case
products.verdict: Inkless thermal printing with a carry case and three paper rolls.
products.description:
The Gloryang is an inkless Bluetooth thermal printer with a carry case and 3 paper rolls, supporting 8.5 by 11 inch thermal paper.

It ranks sixth because thermal printing is monochrome and needs special paper, unlike the inkjets above, but it stores tidily.

It suits drawer storage and light printing. The caveat is the paper.

products.name: NDYIN Portable Printer Wireless, N80 Bluetooth Inkless Thermal Printer
products.verdict: The smallest option, with no ink cartridges to store.
products.description:
The N80 is an inkless Bluetooth thermal printer supporting Letter and A4 thermal paper, with iOS, Android and laptop compatibility.

It ranks last because it ships without the carry case and rolls of the Gloryang, though it is in the $25 to $50 tier.

It suits tiny spaces. The caveat is thermal paper cost and no color.

whatMatters.detail: Cartridges are cheap upfront but cost more over time, while tanks refill from bottles and thermal printers need special paper. Check the listing for cartridge-free or inkless wording.
A flatbed scanner lets one device replace two. It matters for forms and receipts. Look for scan and copy in the title.
Duplex prints both sides automatically and saves paper. Check for duplex in the title.
Wireless suits shared use, Bluetooth suits phones. Confirm which is listed.
Battery power lets a printer work away from an outlet. Look for a rechargeable battery in the specs.

faq.a: No. The NDYIN and Gloryang are inkless and use thermal paper.

faq.q: What mistake do buyers make with mini printers?
faq.a: Ignoring ongoing ink cost. Compare cartridge and tank systems.

faq.q: Is the EcoTank worth it over the Canon TS4320?
faq.a: If you print often, the tanks target lower running cost.

faq.q: How do I set one up?
faq.a: Use the maker's app to connect to Wi-Fi or Bluetooth.
Keep it covered and use paper types listed in the specs.

faq.q: Can I print from a phone?
faq.a: The NDYIN lists iOS and Android support, and the HP uses the HP Smart app.

finalTake: The Epson EcoTank ET-2800 is the best mini printer here for anyone who prints regularly. The Canon TR160 is the only real portable, and the thermal models suit tiny spaces and light use.
